rows.jyutping: V dak1 hou2 jau5 gin3 dei6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for carrying out an action with insight.

example.english: You analyzed it insightfully, and everyone immediately understood where the problem was.
example.traditional: 你分析得好有見地，大家即刻明白問題喺邊。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan1 sik1 dak1 hou2 jau5 gin3 dei6 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 ming4 baak6 man6 tai4 hai2 bin1

rows.note: Use this when the insight consists of seeing through a situation or understanding it deeply.

example.english: You insightfully saw through it and knew that they were really just trying to avoid responsibility.
example.traditional: 你睇得好透，知道佢其實只係想推卸責任。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 dak1 hou2 tau3 zi1 dou6 keoi5 kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 soeng2 teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam6

rows.note: Use this when the insightful action is especially incisive and gets straight to the key point.

example.english: They insightfully pointed out that the biggest problem with this plan was the lack of staff.
example.traditional: 佢一針見血咁指出，呢個計劃最大問題係冇人手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 zam1 gin3 hyut3 gam3 zi2 ceot1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 daai6 man6 tai4 hai6 mou5 jan4 sau2
